_comment_purpose: Quality gate catalog. A gate is a named check or reviewer goal that an agent identity must satisfy. Reviewer-swarm goals reference this catalog via id; reviewer identities compose the same gates via `qualityGates`. Three gate kinds are supported: `checks` (CI-style command), `review-goal` (specialized reviewer focus), and `command` (manual command).

gates.description: Run the project's TypeScript type check (tsc --noEmit or equivalent) before marking work complete.
Run `git diff --check` on the working tree to catch whitespace/conflict-marker errors.

Architecture Boundaries Reviewer: block god-file growth, mixed concerns, unclear module ownership, duplicated config/prompt/model definitions, leaky abstractions, and refactors that do not improve dependency direction.
TypeScript Correctness Reviewer: block unsafe any/type assertions at boundaries, weak parameter parsing, uncaught runtime shape errors, broken imports, and logic that is not locally verifiable.
Validation and Evidence Reviewer: block missing or weak checks, vague handoffs, unverified behavior-preserving refactors, and changes without concrete command output or manual inspection evidence.
Security and Concurrency Reviewer: block secret/env leakage, unsafe subprocess/file handling, swallowed errors that hide data loss, lock/race regressions, and unsafe filesystem mutations.
